summary: Phase 2 (Daily Deals + Quick Buy Again + new category labels) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass — GET /api/deals returns the 3 seeded deals (Bitter Gourd 30%, Asparagus 14%, Cabbage 16%) with correct deal_price math and full enriched shape; POST /api/admin/deals requires admin token (returns 401 without); full CRUD lifecycle (create→appears in public list→PATCH active=false hides it→re-activate→DELETE→gone) works; POST with invalid product_id returns 400; DELETE unknown id returns 404. GET /api/orders/quick-buy-again requires auth (401 without), returns [] for a brand-new user, and returns items sorted by order_count descending after seeding orders. Regression: /api/products still returns 164, product-detail + pincode-check still work. Frontend: Home shows the new 5 category labels in order (Pre-cut · Ready Mix · Organic · Regular · Fruits) in BOTH the quick strip and the 'Shop by category' section. Daily Deals section renders with 🔥 pulse, 'LIVE' pill, and 3 horizontal cards with -30% / -14% / -16% discount badges, strikethrough original price, deal price, and 'Grab' button (Grab tap adds item to cart without error). Quick Buy Again is hidden for guests (verified), and appears with items sorted by order_count for a logged-in user after placing orders. Admin panel /admin now has 3 tabs (Products, Deals, PINs). Deals tab shows 40 product chips + discount %/banner text inputs + Publish button + existing deals list with pause/resume + delete. UI publish of a new deal (25%, 'UI Test Deal') persists, appears in public /api/deals immediately, and can be deleted via admin token — cleanup successful. OTP + LocationSheet from Phase 1 continue to work.

react_native_issues.issue: React warning still logs: 'React does not recognize the defaultMuted prop on a DOM element.' Same issue flagged in iteration_11 — not fixed. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:50 — remove defaultMuted (the `muted` attribute is enough).

Console warns repeatedly: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking on web preview. Reference: theme.shadow.* usage across StyleSheet and LinearGradient pointerEvents="none"/"box-none" in (tabs)/index.tsx:194,196.

action_items: None required for Phase 2 scope — feature can be marked complete.
(Carry-over from iteration_11) Remove `defaultMuted` prop from <video> in HeroVideo (index.tsx:50) — muted attribute is sufficient; will silence a repeating React DOM warning.
(Carry-over) Migrate deprecated `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and inline `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` for RN 0.75+ compliance (visual-only, no functional impact).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1400+ lines — deals + quick-buy-again added inline. Consider splitting into routers/deals.py, routers/orders.py etc. before Phase 3.

/api/admin/deals PATCH uses a query param (?active=bool) rather than a JSON body — works but inconsistent with the rest of the admin surface (POST/DELETE bodies). Consider a small pydantic model for consistency.
quick-buy-again scans last 30 orders in-Python; fine at current scale but should move to a MongoDB aggregation ($unwind + $group + $sort) once real users have >30 orders.
_enrich_deal issues an extra products.find per deal — N+1. Prefetch product ids into one $in query for /api/deals if the deal list grows past ~20.
HomeSections.tsx (289 lines) mixes two distinct sections + shared styles. Fine for now but split into separate files if either section grows.
Frontend admin.tsx does the deal PATCH via `?active=` query string which is correct for the current backend contract — kept in sync.

No missing testIDs — all interactive elements in the new UI have testID (deal-card-*, deal-add-*, quick-item-*, quick-add-*, tab-deals, admin-d-pct, admin-d-banner, admin-d-submit, admin-d-product-*, admin-toggle-*, admin-del-deal-*).
seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up one deal (banner='UI Test Deal') and places 3 orders (2 Onion + 1 Potato) for mobile user +919876500099 / +919876500088 (idempotent — synthetic email accounts). No admin data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 fully verified. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_deals_qba.py is idempotent and safe to re-run. Seeded deals (Bitter Gourd 30%, Asparagus 14%, Cabbage 16%) are created by dev and expected to remain. QuickBuyAgain hides itself when items.length===0 OR user is null, so a guest home should never show it. To auth as admin in Playwright, set localStorage.auth_token = <token from POST /api/auth/login> BEFORE navigating to /admin (AsyncStorage uses key 'auth_token' on web). Location gate uses localStorage.freshcuts_location.
